verdict: A mid-week spend gap cut results; recovery is underway but incomplete.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 114 leads at an average cost of $5.56 per lead, but that picture was disrupted by three consecutive days of zero ad spend around September 22–24, which caused leads and site traffic to fall sharply in the back half of the period. Spend has been rebuilding since September 28 — $33 to $52 per day — and leads are following, though cost per lead is currently running higher than the $3.28 peak seen earlier in the month while delivery stabilises. Several foundational build items — including landing pages, search campaigns, and CRM setup — are still outstanding well past their original dates, which limits how efficiently the active campaigns can perform. Those items are being completed now, and once in place they will give paid traffic a more reliable path to convert; next period should reflect a more complete stack.

watch_item.issue: A three-day gap in ad delivery mid-period caused a 70% drop in weekly leads and a 50% spike in cost per lead in the last 7 days.
watch_item.fix: Spend has been restored and is climbing daily; budget pacing is being monitored closely to prevent another gap.
